# Master services agreement

Counterparty: Northbridge Analytics, Inc.
Effective: 4 June 2021
Term: 24 months. The agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the then-current term ends.

Northbridge: sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics". Billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc." A 2024 credit check also returned a Wyoming LLC, "Northbridge Analytics LLC". Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party. Treat that registry link as unresolved.

selection_rationale: Identity verdict for (crm:NBA-102, contract:MSA-NBA-2021) requires comparing name forms across CRM, billing, contract, registry, and explicit commercial notes.
known_missing_information: Purpose B policy verdict (SAME_ENTITY/DISTINCT/UNRESOLVED) not yet established; P2 made no identity assertions.
